name: Zymotic
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Edward Kim: Humanity's Hammer, Order and Chaos's Anarch identity, who trashes the first operation he accesses each turn. Zeitgeist's list, its identity swapped, with two Time Bomb for a Skulljack and a Brain Cage, brain damage for a cheaper trash and a bigger hand, which Zeitgeist keeps. Named to sort after every other Runner deck, so the sweep schedule of those before it does not move. Eternal-legal only: Order and Chaos is in neither pool. FFG F7 Stage 4. SanSan Stage 19: two Ice Carvers became DDoS and Paige Piper. SanSan Stage 20: The Toolbox became Turntable. SanSan Stage 28 swapped a Xanadu, kept elsewhere, for a Virus Breeding Ground. Adjusted Chronotype (SanSan Stage 32) for one Liberated Account, which four other decks keep. Two Nerve Agent take Hantu's place. Two Keyhole take Stargate's place. An Ekomind takes Marrow's place, one console for another. Two Disrupter take Take a Dive's place. Two Overmind take Friend of a Friend's place. One Mimic became an Ixodidae, so the sweeps hear the Corp losing credits (Engine words, Stage 3). Engine words Stage 11 brought the Caïssa programs and Deep Red in for two Katorga Breakouts, two Chastushkas and a Liberated Account, so the sweep plays programs installed on ice. Engine words Stage 18 brought an Archives Interface in for a Cyberfeeder, so the sweep removes a card in Archives from the game instead of accessing it. Engine words Stage 24 (FFG): a Tallie Perrault for one of its The Nihilists; an Angel Arena for one of its Scrubbers. Engine words Stage 25 (FFG): an Inject for one of its two En Passant.
